prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1030; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss from insured. Insured reports vehicle was struck on the driver side while the insured was turning left at an intersection. Insured states the other driver ran a red signal. Police report number pending. No visible injuries reported by insured at scene.

Entry 2: Contacted third-party driver. Driver disputes the signal phase and states the insured entered the intersection late. Recorded statement requested. Scene photos obtained from insured and placed in file.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received. All further contact to be routed through counsel. Claimant reports neck and lower back strain following the collision and has begun treatment. Medical records requested through counsel.

Entry 4: Reviewed intersection traffic camera footage obtained from the municipality. Footage partially covers the approach. Signal timing records requested to confirm phase at time of impact. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure pending medical documentation.

Entry 5: Counsel's office confirmed receipt of records request and indicated a demand package will follow once treatment concludes. Liability remains disputed. Recommend referral to subrogation unit for recovery against the other carrier. File diary set for follow-up in thirty days.
